The exact event-type mapping is under-specified in the contract and needs a ruling.

observed: UNPROVEN: distinctness-from-fill is proven at shape level (event_type != fill/order, kind=financing); asserting the exact event_type mapping would assert an unratified value. Flag for ruling.

description: AC6 requires 'any stochastic term draws from a per-run seed ... so replay reproduces the same draw'. The five V1 slippage models (zero, constant-percent, spread-crossing, gap-volatility, size-tiered) are all DETERMINISTIC; slip_fill takes a seed but discards it (del seed). The per-run-seed derivation is proven deterministic, but no model consumes it, so the end-to-end 'reproduces the same draw' cannot be exercised.
expected: A stochastic slippage model that consumes the per-run seed, whose replay reproduces the identical draw.
observed: UNPROVEN/unimplemented in V1: no stochastic term is applied (models deterministic); seed derivation is proven deterministic (T-17.3-n green), but the stochastic-draw reproduction is untestable end-to-end until a stochastic model exists.
